items.basis: No evidence demonstrates that a 5nm ALD titania coating on bronze pores significantly improves droplet wetting and drainage compared to uncoated bronze at 8 bar pressure
8 bar pressure and 5 m3/h flow rate will likely cause catastrophic coating delamination and pore blockage due to pressure cycling and flow turbulence
The candidate provides zero evidence contradicting the known failure mode of coating abrasion by particulate in high-flow compressed air systems
The predicted dew point improvement from 12C to 3C equivalent lacks validation data and likely cannot be achieved with such a thin coating under actual operating conditions
Achieving uniform 5nm ALD coating across all internal pores of a sintered bronze element at commercial scale is technologically infeasible with current manufacturing methods
The testable prediction fails to specify temperature, humidity, and particulate load conditions during testing, making the dew point measurement unverifiable
